statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73, G45.9, and I48.0
The denial reason code is CO-97
The monitoring is clinically necessary to identify the arrhythmic etiology of the patient's symptoms
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
